name: branding-line-shield-badge-with-sword-and-lightning
title: Monoline pennant shield with upright sword and lightning wings for a military unit
whatItIs: A white slide with small caps corner labels and a black outline pennant shield holding the text 'THUNDER DIVISION', a sword with jagged lightning crosspieces, nested chevron lines and '2/32'.
whatItMeans: Disciplined and heraldic; uniform line weight keeps it crisp for patches.
techniques: Build a badge from nested uniform lines.
Turn a sword's crossguard into lightning wings.
Set text in a squared display face inside the shield.
Keep in black line on white.

vocabulary.definition: A shield with a pointed bottom.
V-shaped lines placed inside each other.
An emblem drawn with one stroke weight.
